## Overview

This is the final week of the R part of the course.
On Monday, we'll analyze RNA-seq gene counts for the data set that you ran the
nf-core _rnaseq_ pipeline on in [week 11](/week11/w11c_nfcore2.qmd),
exploring the data with a PCA, identifying differentially expressed genes.

On Wednesday, we will have a guest lecture,
in which prof. Jessica Cooperstone will [TODO].

## Learning goals

Some of the things you will learn this week:

#### [R for omics data I: RNA-seq count data analysis](./w15a_rnaseq.qmd)

- What Bioconductor is, and how to install its packages
- How to create a DESeq2 object that incorporates both the count data and the metadata
- How to perform exploratory data analysis, including a PCA
- How to run a Differential Expression (DE) analysis
- How to extract and visualize the DE results, including with a volcano plot
